tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student organizing a study group for an upcoming final exam in your chemistry class. You need to invite your classmates and suggest a meeting time and place. You also want to provide some guidelines for the study session to ensure it is productive. Write an email to your classmates.
bullets: Invite them to join the study group.
Recommend a time and place for the meeting.
Provide the most important guidelines to ensure your classmates are prepared.
tasks.subject: Invitation to a Final Exam Study Group
